q: Which endpoint gives me the status of access requests, what can I filter on and how do I paginate?

filters on accessRequestId, accountActivityItemId, created (with their operators)
query params requested-for / requested-by / regarding-identity / assigned-to
limit max 250 + offset (record-based)
stable sorters (created, modified, accountActivityItemId, name)
must_not: filtering on status with this endpoint

q: I want the approvals waiting for me. Endpoint and filters?
must: GET /access-request-approvals/v1/pending
filters id, requestedFor.id, accessRequestId (eq,in), created/modified (comparisons)
sorters created, modified

q: How do I list uncorrelated accounts of one source via API?
must: GET /accounts/v1
filters sourceId eq "..." and uncorrelated eq true
paginate limit 250

q: My script calls /v3/access-request-status. What is the new path after the June 2026 versioning change?
must: /access-request-status/v1
per-service versioning
legacy paths still work until end of support (Q2 2028 supported / off 2029 or 'announced end of support')

q: What Content-Type and body format does a PATCH to a source need?

JSON Patch array of operations (op, path, value)

q: What is the ISC API rate limit and how should my client react?

keyed per client_id (and API version)
429 with Retry-After
retry with backoff

q: Filter syntax: is 'name EQ "Finance"' valid in filters?
must: operators must be lowercase (eq)
strings in double quotes

q: How do I page through more than 10,000 search results?

sort on a unique field like id
pass the last record's sort values

q: Which workflow trigger should I use to do something when an employee changes department?

filter $.changes[?(@.attribute == "department")]

the Weekly/Daily options take times; check in the UI whether 06:30 is accepted (a SailPoint example stores a :30 weekly time)
runs can overlap

q: In a loop, how do I read the current item and data from a step before the loop?

$.loop.context with Context set on the loop
only Loop Input and Context visible inside

q: Max number of items a parallel workflow loop can process?

serial loop 1000

q: After Manage Access, can my workflow wait until the access is approved and provisioned?

use a second workflow on Access Request Decision
Wait step if waiting for source provisioning
failedAccessRequests does not fail the execution

q: How do I put the user's display name inside the Send Email body?

${name} in body
or inline {{$.step.field}}

q: Our admin who built all workflows is leaving. Any risk?
must: creator is owner and a personal access token is created
workflows become orphaned and fail with unauthorized
reassign owner or recreate before they leave

q: Which trigger lets ServiceNow start a workflow, and how does it authenticate?
must: External Trigger
OAuth client (client id/secret) from + New Access Token
POST /workflows/v1/execute/external/{id} with input
read input with $.trigger.<field>

q: In Access Request Submitted workflows, how do I get the requested item: requestedItemsStatus?
must: Access Request Submitted payload has requestedItem (singular)
requestedItemsStatus belongs to Access Request Decision

q: What variables do I get on the error branch of an action?
must: Enable Error Handling creates success/error branches
workflowErrorMessage
workflowStatusCode

q: I want an external service to approve or deny access requests before the normal approvals. Which trigger and what must it return?
must: Access Request Submitted idn:access-request-pre-approval REQUEST_RESPONSE
response approved, comment, approver
one subscription only
no correct answer in time => request fails

q: How long does my endpoint have to answer a SYNC request/response trigger and what if I need longer?
must: 10 seconds
ASYNC: reply 200 {} then POST to callbackURL with secret before responseDeadline
DYNAMIC option

q: How many subscribers can a fire-and-forget trigger have?
Write a trigger filter that fires only when lifecycle state becomes terminated.
must: $.changes[?(@.attribute == "cloudLifecycleState" && @.newValue == "terminated")]
on Identity Attributes Changed

q: How can I validate a trigger filter via API?
must: POST /trigger-subscriptions/v1/validate-filter (or beta path)
body with input sample and filter
escape quotes

q: Which email is sent when an access request is denied, to whom, and which variables can I use?

variables approved, approverName, rejecterName, reviewerComment, requestedObjectName, requesterName …

q: How do I stop ISC from sending one specific email?
must: first word of subject no_send or Stop
overrides process settings, careful with password reset/certifications

q: Can I use $user in the Non-Employee Request Created template?

use $__recipient / $__util

q: My test email shows empty variables. Bug?
must: test emails render only global variables
conditional sections excluded
test with a real event / redirect to test address

q: Can I put a <style> block and an HTML comment in a template?
must: no: sanitizer, no head/comments
use inline style attributes

q: Can I set a different From address on one template?

must be verified

swap positive/negative condition or use lookup

q: File name convention for submitting a cloud rule?

q: Find who updated a role last month in audit events.
must: index events
technicalName ROLE_UPDATE_PASSED (or action)
created:[now-1M TO now]

q: Is .exact supported on email?

q: What ordering does GET list work items have?

q: Which notification reaches the certifier when a campaign starts, and which attributes can I add?

campaign.* (name, deadlineDate, activationDate, type, reviewerType, description, id)
certification.* (id, name, reviewerName, totalItems, totalSubjects, signDate), requesterName, recipientId

q: I need a workflow that runs a PowerShell when an AD attribute is modified, only for employees.
must: Account Updated trigger with filter on singleValueAttributeChanges name (ID from workflow-library)
check source is AD and account correlated
Get Identity + Compare Strings on the employee-type identity attribute
run PowerShell via HTTP Request to an automation endpoint or the PTA Windows Server action (licence/VA)

q: I need a transform that takes the AD attribute UPN and keeps only the part before @.

input accountAttribute sourceName + attributeName userPrincipalName

q: How does account correlation decide which identity an account belongs to when I configure several attribute pairs? What if none matches?
must: pairs are tried one at a time in order and the first matching pair correlates (not an AND of all pairs)
operation is Equals only, case-insensitive by default
fallback: account name compared with the identity name

q: I changed the correlation configuration of a source and re-ran aggregation from the UI, but old accounts are still uncorrelated. Why, and how do I fix it?
must: optimized aggregation skips unchanged accounts and does not re-evaluate correlation
run an aggregation with disableOptimization=true via POST /sources/v1/{id}/load-accounts (API only; UI runs are always optimized)
must_not: says a UI checkbox disables optimization

q: How does the account delete threshold work, and which aggregations can delete accounts?
must: percentage of the source's accounts (deleteThreshold 0-100)
if exceeded, the delete phase is skipped with a warning
deletes only in full aggregations with account deletion enabled; delta/single-account aggregations do not delete
must_not: says it is an absolute number of accounts

q: In a create profile, my mail field uses a static Velocity value "$uid@corp.com" but mail comes out wrong. uid is generated by Create Unique Account ID further down. What's wrong?
must: fields are computed in list order: uid must be placed before mail
static values can reference earlier fields only (generator patterns cannot reference other fields)

q: What are the main limits of attribute sync in ISC?
must: only existing correlated accounts are updated (it never creates accounts)
only attributes in Create Account mapped directly from an identity attribute
the built-in Manager attribute cannot be synced
case-sensitive; bulk sync at most 3 times per 24h per source
must_not: says attribute sync creates missing accounts

q: How do I schedule account and entitlement aggregation of a source through the API?
must: POST /sources/v1/{sourceId}/schedules
type ACCOUNT_AGGREGATION or GROUP_AGGREGATION
cronExpression is a Quartz cron (seconds first, ? in day-of-month or day-of-week)

q: I enabled native change detection but no Native Change triggers fire. What do I check?
must: at least one operation (ACCOUNT_CREATED/UPDATED/DELETED) and at least one attribute/entitlement must be selected
changes are detected only when an aggregation runs
triggers: Native Change Account Created/Updated/Deleted
must_not: says NCD detects changes in real time without aggregation

q: How do I update the create profile of a source via API? Can a source have several CREATE policies?
must: PUT /sources/v1/{sourceId}/provisioning-policies/CREATE (GET first, edit, PUT back)

q: How can I list uncorrelated accounts of a source via API and correlate them in bulk?
must: GET /accounts/v1 with filters sourceId eq "..." and uncorrelated eq true

manual links are flagged manuallyCorrelated=true and survive unoptimized aggregation

q: A colleague wants to add PROVISIONING to the features array of our SailPoint-supported JDBC source to enable provisioning. Good idea?

q: I want to create a contractor in SailPoint NERM via API. Which URL do I call and what does the body look like?
must: POST https://{tenant}.nonemployee.com/api/profile (one) or /api/profiles (many) — NERM host, not api.identitynow.com
body is wrapped: {"profile": {...}} (or {"profiles": [...]})
profile_type_id and status are required; attributes is an object keyed by attribute uid

q: How do I authenticate to the NERM API today? Can I use my ISC personal access token?
must: yes: exchange the ISC PAT (client credentials) at https://{isc-tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token and send the JWT as Bearer to NERM
legacy NERM API keys (Admin > System > Api) are deprecated and do not support scopes
tenants created after June 2025 must use ISC credentials (legacy keys not available); access follows the PAT owner's access/scopes
must_not: says the PAT client secret itself is sent as the bearer token
says only NERM API keys work

q: Which NERM API scope should I give an integration that only needs to start workflow sessions and read profiles, and what happens if a scope is missing?
must: nerm:api:workflow-operator (read profiles, profile types, workflows, advanced search; read and execute workflow sessions)

nerm:general:manage would work but grants full admin; scopes only exist on ISC tokens, not legacy keys
must_not: invents scopes like nerm:profiles:read or sp:scopes:all for this

q: I need to export all ~200,000 NERM profiles nightly. How should I page through /profiles?
must: use keyset paging with after_id (last id of the previous page), sorted by id ascending
after_id cannot be combined with offset, and other filters except profile_type_id/limit (and updated_after) are ignored or rejected
limit max 500 on /profiles (default 100); metadata=true returns _metadata with next/total; updated_after for incremental
must_not: says use filters= or count=true like ISC
says limit 250 or 10000 for NERM profiles

q: I created a NERM workflow session with POST /workflow_sessions and it just sits there. Why?
must: the session only runs if ?run=true is passed (default false); otherwise it is saved
start it with PATCH /workflow_sessions/{id}?run=true (or create with run=true)
body is {"workflow_session": {workflow_id, requester_id, requester_type, ...}} with those three required; profile_id for update, profile_ids for batch
must_not: says sessions are queued for the daily automated run

q: How do I find, via the NERM API, all non-terminated profiles whose first name starts with 'a'?
must: POST /advanced_search/run with {"advanced_search": {"condition_rules_attributes": [...]}}
a ProfileStatusRule with != Terminated plus a ProfileAttributeRule on the first-name attribute id with comparison_operator start_with?

must_not: uses a filters=firstName sw "a" query parameter

q: What is the difference between SailPoint NERM and the Non-Employee Lifecycle Management in Identity Security Cloud?
must: NELM is built into ISC: non-employee sources and records with approvals, API /non-employee-sources, /non-employee-records on api.identitynow.com
NERM is a separate add-on product (ex SecZetta) on {tenant}.nonemployee.com with its own API, profile types/relationships, configurable workflows, external portal and risk scoring
NERM profiles reach ISC through the NERM connector as a source (identities)
must_not: says they are the same product or the same API

q: How is a profile's overall risk score calculated in NERM, and which attributes can carry risk?
must: only option-based attributes: drop-down, check boxes, radio buttons, profile search, profile select (inherited only for profile search/select)
overall score = average of the average impact and the average probability (0-10, two decimals); a linked/inherited profile with higher risk overrides
risk is disabled by default and enabled per profile type; mitigation attributes reduce risk
must_not: says text fields or dates can carry risk
says overall is the sum or the maximum of all attributes

q: We sync NERM non-employees to ISC. Which attribute correlates the accounts, which profiles get aggregated, and do all attributes sync?
must: Non-Employee Profile ID is aggregated automatically and mapped to Employee Number; default correlation Non-Employee Profile ID = Employee Number
only person profile types (core Non-Employees, custom employee/non-employee categories); status filter All or Active (Active + On Leave); archived profiles never aggregated
only mapped core attributes sync (First Name, Last Name, Business Email required); extended attributes do not; schema attributes are strings, no entitlement aggregation
must_not: says correlation is on email by default
says terminated/archived profiles are aggregated by default as active

q: In a NERM automated workflow I put Status Change to Terminated before the manager approval step and a REST API step that calls a slow service. Any problem?
must: Status Change takes effect immediately, so the profile is terminated before approval: move it after the approval
REST API action times out after 60 seconds and the workflow session fails
automated workflows run once a day at a fixed, region-dependent time (not on demand)
must_not: says status change waits for the approval automatically

q: What exactly do I need to send SailPoint to get a cloud rule reviewed, and how should the file be named?
must: support portal request (or support email) with the rule file, validator output, tenant name and approval for Expert Services hours
file named 'Rule - {type} - {name}.xml' matching the Rule type and name attributes
review is an integrity check against guidelines, not a check that the rule works; ~24h SLA weekdays

q: My IdentityAttribute rule uses context.getObjectByName(Identity.class, managerId) to read the manager's email. Will it pass review? What should I use?
must: no: context and .getObjectByName() are on SailPoint's code-restriction list; new rules using them are returned
use IdnRuleUtil helpers via idn, e.g. idn.getIdentityById(id) or idn.findIdentitiesBySearchableIdentityAttribute(attr, "Equals", value, sortAttr)
consider a transform (e.g. reference/manager attribute) instead of a rule
must_not: says context is allowed read-only in cloud rules

q: Which logging practices get an ISC rule rejected?
must: logging sensitive data (passwords, secrets, personal data) is prohibited and causes rejection
System.out/System.err and declaring your own logger are not allowed; use the provided log with debug/info/warn/error
log.error only for real errors; no full object serialization such as .toXml()
must_not: says System.out is fine because it goes to the VA log

q: I need to update an approved BeforeProvisioning rule but control exactly when the new logic goes live. How?
must: keep one rule per use case; versioned copies are not supported
submit '<original name>-TEMP', switch to it in the change window, validate, then update the original, switch back and ask to delete TEMP
need a specific window: tell SailPoint at least 48 hours in advance
must_not: recommends creating 'rule v2' and keeping both permanently

q: A colleague's AttributeGenerator rule calls idn.countIdentitiesBySearchableIdentityAttribute("email", "Contains", value) and loops over identity.getLinks(). Problems?
must: operation must be Equals or StartsWith (Contains is not supported) and the attribute must be searchable
iterating over accounts/identities (getLinks) is against the performance guidelines (cache bloat): use a targeted idn lookup
uniqueness checks are fine in AttributeGenerator rules (they are discouraged in IdentityAttribute rules)

q: Can I import my IdentityIQ XML objects (rules, applications, workflows) into Identity Security Cloud?
must: no direct import: ISC does not read IIQ XML; objects are rebuilt (UI, API, sp-config for supported ISC objects)

must_not: says sp-config imports IIQ export files
source: Developer Community migration threads; SailPoint upgrade program

q: What happens to my IIQ AfterProvisioning rule that opens a ServiceNow ticket after an AD account is disabled?
must: ISC has no AfterProvisioning rule type

must_not: says to convert it to an AfterProvisioning cloud rule

q: Our IIQ HR application has a Correlation rule, a Creation rule and a ResourceObjectCustomization rule. What do they become in ISC?
must: Correlation: use the source correlation config (attribute pairs) first; only if impossible a Correlation cloud rule returning identityAttributeName/identityAttributeValue without context
Creation: no creation rule; identity profile attribute mappings with transforms
Customization: no customization rule; transforms where values are used (BuildMap for file/JDBC, connector customizer for SaaS)
must_not: says all three can be submitted as ISC cloud rules unchanged

q: We use IIQ QuickLinks, custom objects and a couple of plugins. What are the ISC options?
must: none of the three exist in ISC
QuickLinks: Request Center for access, Forms plus workflows (external trigger) for custom actions
custom objects: transform lookup tables/attributes or an external store; plugins: external apps using the ISC APIs (UI Development Kit)
must_not: says custom objects can be migrated to ISC as-is

q: How do IIQ business roles with an IdentitySelector rule and IIQ CertificationExclusion rules migrate?
must: IdentitySelector rules are deprecated in ISC: use role membership (standard assignment) criteria
CertificationExclusion rules are deprecated: use campaign filters
business roles become ISC roles (containing access profiles/entitlements); IT roles usually access profiles
